record.paper_title: Some open problems in the theory of almost periodic functions
record.original_question: Develop the theory of the spaces APr for functions taking values in Banach spaces, extending the scalar-valued APr framework to Banach-space-valued almost periodic objects.

evidence.quote: f) Build up the theory of APr spaces in case of functions with values in Banach spaces.

artifact.status_search_result: Significant portions of the program have been carried out: Banach-space-valued Stepanov, Weyl and Besicovitch almost periodic function spaces have been studied by several authors (e.g., Andres–Bersani–Grande, Kostić, Khalladi et al., and recent works on (ω,c)-almost periodicity), including Stepanov generalizations with values in Banach spaces and associated composition/convolution theorems. However, a fully unified theory addressing all structural questions (Bohr–Fourier theory, dependence on Banach space geometry, full equivalence of definitions in the vector-valued $AP^r$ setting) does not appear to be completely settled, so the overall program is best classified as partially solved.

status_evidence.title: A note on spaces of almost periodic functions with values in Banach spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Studies spaces of almost periodic functions taking values in Banach spaces.
status_evidence.claim: Banach-valued almost periodic function spaces have been developed in the literature.

status_evidence.title: Stepanov and Weyl Classes of c-Almost Periodic Type Functions
status_evidence.snippet: Introduces Stepanov and Weyl classes of c-almost periodic functions with values in a Banach space X.
status_evidence.claim: Stepanov-type almost periodic functions with values in Banach spaces have been developed.

status_evidence.title: Almost periodic and asymptotically almost periodic functions: part I
status_evidence.snippet: Reviews properties of almost periodic and asymptotically almost periodic functions in Banach spaces, with Stepanov generalizations.
status_evidence.claim: Stepanov generalizations of almost periodic functions in Banach spaces are an active area of study.
